purpose: Materialize natural-budget continued-pretraining blocks from audited Raw, Normal, and Hard confirmatory outputs.

packing.tail_rule: Drop only the final incomplete sequence and final incomplete gradient-accumulation group; never impose a target fraction, max-token budget, or equal-token resampling.

raw_audited_natural.role: benchmark-excluded collected corpus before runtime curation

claim_boundary: This artifact freezes external natural-budget training inputs. It does not alter runtime curation, read Utility or benchmark outcomes, or establish downstream performance.
